option_relations.rationale: The option describes a specific conduction abnormality (RBBB) and a cause of cardiac arrest (hypoxemia from COPD exacerbation), neither of which is directly related to the broad category of Cardiomyopathy.
Malignant arrhythmia or conduction system abnormality are distinct cardiac conditions and not directly related to Cardiomyopathy, which refers to a disease of the heart muscle itself.
Acute exacerbation of COPD leading to respiratory failure is a pulmonary condition and has no direct relation to Cardiomyopathy.
Acute COPD exacerbation with respiratory failure is a pulmonary condition and has no direct relation to Cardiomyopathy.
